status.scope: WP1–WP10 in the local candidate code; WP12 documentation only. No deployment, Porthole parity or WP13 acceptance claim.
status.keypathStatusNote: All GET/SET keypaths declared in this v0 contract have implemented handlers after WP10. No declared keypath remains a not-implemented stub. Implemented does not mean every payload or missing source succeeds; unsupported future keypaths are not invented here.
implementationLimits: Projection is evidence only; purposes, packages and signed approvals never grant rights. Fleet selection is local and owner-scoped. Unverifiable EntityAnchor Contracts are omitted and state.verified=false reports the source gap.

PurposeBoundAIGateway has no readable current route/instruction. modelRoute and instruction are optional and absent there. Ordinary AIGateway state.draft is projected only as a draft; AIAssistantThread/persona instruction binding is not implemented.
adjust.credentials and adjust.webfetchWrite are implemented, but isOn=true always returns expansion_not_allowed for WebFetch v0. False retains allowCredentials=false and methods=[GET].

The first nonempty whitelist on an uninitialized WebFetch ceiling can be set within the template maximum; later trustPackage adjustments must be subsets of current patterns. Blank text/lines are invalid_pattern. Direct owner webFetch.ceiling.set remains a separate administration path.

Ceilings and bindings use existing per-instance Codable/resolver snapshots, not a new EntityAnchor ceiling table. Only approval records use signedAgreementEntity.commit. Multi-cell writes are not a distributed transaction.

fleet.set and approve do not automatically bind targets. Only explicitly bound WebFetch/PurposeBoundAIGateway invocations use the fail-closed port; unbound cells keep existing authorization/ceiling checks. fleet.stop blocks new admissions, not in-flight cancellation.

The packageDigest omits only its own top-level field. The compact package ceiling omits maxBytes/followRedirects; signed approval policyDigests bind the complete operational data, instance and permissions, so these changes still close the port.

ActionDecisionReceipt v1 has opaque destination/data/plan digests and signed checks, not a readable route/tools list. Unreadable AI input or missing intent can return without a receipt; narrowed effective policy versus template receipt digest is conservatively unknown_policy_version.

EffectReceipt stores host-only destination metadata, no URL path/query, port, redirect target, credential alias or caller-agent. credentialsUsed=false in v0. new_destination/credential_resolved can describe signed denied attempts, not completed effects.

Receipt stores are append-only at the API boundary, not a deletion-proof or hash-chained journal. Removal before first fleet collection cannot be detected. Source/snapshot/persistence gaps prevent an Overholdt audit result.

Snapshot/reload is tested; full host restart/durable disk I/O and Porthole/Binding navigation are not verified. WP10 full XCTest retained 46 known baseline-red test names; Swift Testing is not covered.

WP10 observed an existing Anthropic destination_not_allowed result from first-ceiling selection in the core authorizer. It was not fixed; positive production-path coverage used OpenAI. Fixture Anthropic metadata is synthetic.
status.fixturesPathRule: Resolve fixtures.* entries relative to fixturesBasePath from the CellProtocolDocuments repository root; the Book copy does not duplicate the fixture directory.

principles: WP8: stored package JSON is never authority. An unexpected package field quarantines the decoded cell as Ikke avledet; approve returns package_not_derived. Only successful explicit owner regeneration/selection clears the marker; untrusted JSON is not retained.
Pakken er en projeksjon av faktiske objekter (agreementTemplate, Contracts, CellExecutionPolicy, provider-rute, instruksjons-digest). Den skrives aldri for hånd.
Pakken gir ingen myndighet (A1 lås 6). En rett som står i pakken men ikke i template/Contract, finnes ikke.
Justering kan bare innsnevre. Templaten i cellen er taket.
Aldri nøkler, aldri prompt-tekst i pakken eller i state. Instruksjoner refereres med keypath + digest.
Ukjent feiler lukket: ceiling uten mønstre = deny all; pakke uten godkjent digest = flåten starter ikke.

trustPackage.state.audit.note: WP10 verifies retained packageSnapshot against the signed approval digest. Unavailable sources or snapshot prevent an Overholdt status. Invalid/unsigned receipt adds unknown_policy_version. AI v1 destination remains opaque; uses signed ceiling checks and reasonCodes, not an invented readable route.

trustPackage.approved.returns: AgentTrustPackageApproval (verified owner snapshot + immutable EntityAnchor record/receipt; revokedAt retained)

trustPackage.audit.receipts.type: object keyed by content digest; original EffectReceipt or ActionDecisionReceipt metadata
trustPackage.audit.receipts.note: WP10 append-only fleet collection; no SET/reset/trim; nested GET returns one receipt. Codable snapshot, not a tamper-proof journal.

trustPackage.adjust.whitelist.note: WP6: first nonempty adjustment from an uninitialized/empty WebFetch ceiling narrows the template maximum. Afterwards every pattern must be a host/port subset of the current target list. Empty or blank lines are invalid_pattern; reapplying identical data is idempotent.

trustPackage.adjust.credentials.note: isOn=true avvises hvis templaten ikke gir credential-rett

trustPackage.approve.effect: issuer-signert snapshot over digest i EntityAnchor
trustPackage.approve.note: WP7: re-read admitted sources, compare current regenerated packageDigest, sign canonical {schema,fleetID,packageDigest,approvedAt,policyDigests} inside a zero-Grant ownerSignedSnapshot Agreement; require verified signedAgreementEntity.commit. policyDigests bind runtime cell UUID, template permissions and complete operational ceilings (including WebFetch maxBytes). No new authority.

trustPackage.fleet.stop.effect: godkjent digest trekkes tilbake → startport nekter
trustPackage.fleet.stop.note: WP7: retain current record and revokedAt in cell snapshot; previous records retained on subsequent approve. Stops new admissions; does not cancel an already admitted in-flight effect.

AgentTrustPackage.packageDigest: sha256 over kanonisk JSON av alt under, domene haven.agent-trust-package.v0

AgentTrustPackageState.deniedAttempts: integer — WP8: monotonic count of owner-denied trustPackage.adjust.* SETs; default 0 on legacy snapshots, owner-read only, no reset, no proposal/identity/secret contents. Codable snapshot; persistence failure does not undo the in-memory denial.
AgentTrustPackageState.hasChangesSinceApproval: bool — true when a stored approval digest differs from the current package; WP6 never creates approval

WebFetchCeiling.matching: `*.x` matcher subdomener av x, ikke x selv; eksakt vert bare seg selv; port må matche om oppgitt, ellers 443; tom liste = deny all; redirect til vert utenfor listen → denied(redirect_outside_whitelist) uten ny request

fleetBinding.persistence: Per-instance Codable data through existing CellResolver.persistCellSnapshot; malformed stored binding fails decoding.
fleetBinding.startPort: Unbound retains existing authority checks. Bound reads trustPackage.approved as verified runtime owner, verifies committed owner signature and fleet binding, then compares regenerated packageDigest and full per-cell policyDigests before credential/cache/network access.
fleetBinding.authority: Purpose and package never grant rights. A valid approval only locks the existing ceiling and permissions.
